spans.s:
mfn. (-त्कः-त्का-त्कं)
1 Regretting, sad, sorrowful.
2 Absent, thinking of something else.
3 Wishing for, desirous of.
m. (-त्कः)
Opportunity, occasion.
E.
उद् up, away, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Much, excessive.
2 Drunk, mad, furious.
3 Proud, haughty.
4

Uneven.
5

Difficult.
6

Superior, high.
m. (-टः)
1 Intoxication, pride.
2 An elephant in rut.
3 Sara [] grass, (Saccharum sara.)
n. (-टं)
1 Woody cassia or its bark.
2 Sarsaparilla.
E.
उत् high, great, and कटच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Sitting on the hams, squatting.

f. (-ण्ठा)
Regretting, missing any thing or person.
E.
उत् much, कठि to be sad, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Regretting, wishing or sorrowing for, distressed, sorrowful.
f. (-ता)
A woman whose husband or lover is absent.
E.
उद् much, कठि to be sad, affix क्त.

f. (-ता)
1 A plant with aromatic seeds, (Pothos officinalis, Rox.) see गजपिप्पली.
2 Regretting, sorrowing for.
E.
उत्क regretting, and तल् abstract aff.

ind.
Bending back the neck.
E.
उद् up, कन्धर the neck.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 What lifts or raises.
2 What piles or heaps, what makes up.
m. (-रः)
A heap, a pile, a stack, &c.
E.
उत् up, and कर what makes, from कृ and ट or अप् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Winnowing corn.
2 Piling it up.
E.
उत् up, and कॄ to scatter, घञ् aff.

f. (-का)
A sort of sweetmeat made with milk, treacle, and ghee.
E.
उत्कर and कन् added.

f. (-का)
A poultice.
E.
उत् before कृ to make, causal form, वुन् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Relating or belonging to a heap, &c.
E.
उत्कर and छ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Cutting over or on.
2 Cutting to pieces.
3 Cutting off.
E.
उद् कृत to cut, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
1 Superior, eminent.
2 Much, excessive.
3 Attractive, drawing.
m. (-र्षः)
1 Excellence, eminence.
2

Excess.
3

Increase.
4

Pulling, pulling up or to.
E.
उत् much, कृष to mark, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
A porter, one who travels with a burden or load.
m. (-लः)
1 A country in the south of India, part of

Orissa.
2

A fowler, a bird-catcher.
E.
उत् and कल to go, अच् aff.

f. (-का)
1 Regretting, missing any thing or person.
2 A bud, an unblown flower.
3 A wave.
4 Wanton sportfulness, dalliance.
E.
उत्, कल to go, वुन and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Regretting, grieving for.
2 Prosperous, rising, increasing.
E.
उत् up, and कल to go or count; part. affix क्त.

f. (-का)
A cow calving every year.
E.
उत्क regretting, and अक to go, अच् and टाप् affs.

n. (-नं)
Hemming, clearing the throat of mucus.
E.
उत् up, and कासन coughing.

f. (-ता)
Kalonji, (Nigella Indica, Rox.)
E.
उत् up, कुञ्च to go crookedly, क्त affix, or with वुन् affix उत्कुञ्चिका.

n. (-नं)
1 Praising, celebrating.
2 Crying, proclaiming.
E.
उत् before कीर्त्त to praise, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Praised, renowned.
2 Proclaimed, promulgated.
E.
उत् aloud, कीर्त्त to praise, क्त aff.

n. (-टं)
Sleeping with the head erect.
E.
उत् neg. and कुट to be crooked, क aff.

m. (-टः)
An umbrella or parasol.
E.
उत् priv. कूट to heat, क aff.

m. (-णः)
A bug.
E.
उत् high, loud, and कुण to call, क affix; also उङ्कुण.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Brought to the bank or shore.
E.
उद्, कूल a bank, nominative verb, affix क्त.

f. (-तिः)
1 Cutting up.
2 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of twenty-six syllables each.
E.
उत् and कृति another metre.

ind.
Having cut out, off, or up.
E.
उद् before कृत to cut, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being cut to pieces.
E.
उत् before कृत to cut, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Excellent, eminent.
2 Superior, best.
3 Much, most, excessive.
4 Drawn, attracted.
E.
उत् before कृष to drag, क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
Excellence, superiority, eminence.
E.
उत्कृष्ट with तल् added; also with त्व, उत्कृष्टत्वं.

m. (-मः)
A good soil.
E.
उत्कृष्ट excellent, and भूमि earth, अण् aff.

n. (-नं)
The best or most respectable form of marriage.
E.
उत्कृ and वेदन marrying.

mf. (-चः-चा)
A bribe.
E.
उत्, कुच to be crooked, क aff.

m. (-कः)
1 The receiver of a bribe.
2 A bribe.
E.
उद्, कुच् to be crooked, वुन् affix or कन् added to the last.

m. (-मः)
1 Going up or out.
2 Progressive increase.
3 Going astray, acting improperly, deviation, transgression.
E.
उत् before क्रम to go, अच् aff.

m. (-मः)
1 Opposition, contrariety.
2 Going, going above, surpassing.
3 Going from or out.
4 Deviating from propriety, transgressing.
E.
उत् out, क्रम to go, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Going up or out.
2 Surpassing, exceeding.
E.
उत् before क्रम to go, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Passed, surpassed, gone over or beyond.
2 Gone forth or out.
3 Trespassing, exceeding.
E.
उत् before क्रम to go, affix क्त.

mfn. (-न्ती-न्तिनी-न्ति)
Passing, passing away, gone, departed.
E.
उत्क्रान्त and इनि aff.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
1 Going over or above, surpassing.
2 Going out.
E.
उत् before क्रम to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Crying, speaking out or aloud, (who or what does so.)
n. (-ष्टं)
1 Crying out, calling, exclaiming.
2 Conversation.
E.
उत्, क्रुश to cry, क्त aff.

m. (-शः)
1 An osprey.
2 Clamour, proclamation.
E.
उन् loud, कुश to cry, affix घञ्.

m. (-दः)
Nausea, sickness.
E.
उत् and क्लेद moisture.

m. (-शः)
Nausea, sickness.
E.
उत् before क्लेश distress.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Thrown upwards, tossed.
2 Thrown out, ejected.
3

Vomited.
4

Rejected, dismissed.
m. (-प्तः)
Thorn apple, (Datura metel and fastuosa.)
E.
उत् up, and क्षिप्त thrown; in the last sense it alludes to the intoxicating qualities of the plant.

f. (-का)
An ornament in the shape of a crescent worn in the upper part of the ear.
E.
उत् up, क्षिप to send, affix क्तिन्; to which कन् and टाप् are then added.

m. (-पः)
1 Throwing or tossing up.
2 Throwing away.
3 Sending, dispatching.
4 Bringing up, vomiting.
E.
उत् before क्षिपि to throw, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Throwing, a thrower, what or who elevates or raises.
2 Who sends or orders.
m. (-कः)
A stealer of clothes, &c.
E.
उत् before क्षिप to throw, ण्वुस्त aff.

n. (-णं)
1 A fan.
2 A kind of basket or bowl used for cleaning corn.
3 Throwing upwards, tossing.
4 Sending, sending away.
5

Vomiting.
6

Taking up.
7 A measure of sixteen Paṇas.
E.
उत् up, क्षिप to throw or send, ल्युट् aff.
